Assumption.description: What was chosen for an edit because the text did not say.
Assumption.title: Assumption

BandMark.description:
Where one area sits on one vibe: a band, one of five, and the bands it spans.

All three are `null` for an area that cannot be placed. It is never drawn
in the middle. The score a vibe is ranked on is not here, and is never shown.
BandMark.title: BandMark

CensusColumns.description: The heading of each column, in the order they are printed.
CensusColumns.title: CensusColumns

CensusKind.description: What a table counts. It is no `FeatureId` and no `TagId`: no spec or edit can name it.
CensusKind.title: CensusKind

CensusLeftOut.description: Why an area has no figure for a table. Nothing is filled in for either.
CensusLeftOut.title: CensusLeftOut

CensusOffer.description: What the closed block of an area's page says. It holds no figure and names no area.
CensusOffer.title: CensusOffer

CensusPanel.description: The census of one area, as its page shows it. Every word but a button's is here.
CensusPanel.title: CensusPanel

CensusPanelRow.description:
One row as it is printed: the area's figure, and the whole city's beside it.

`share` and `city_share` are words. `percent` and `city_percent` are the
same shares as whole numbers, for the picture alone, and are `None`
where the share is under 1 in 100. `count` is as it is printed, and is
`None` where the share is under 1 in 100: a small count is never given.
CensusPanelRow.title: CensusPanelRow

Clarify.description: An edit whose place or area could not be settled, and what to offer instead.
Clarify.title: Clarify

CompareRow.description:
One thing that counts, across the areas. The journeys have a row each.

Every cell of a journey's row is to the same place. The row is named as
core keys a journey, `commute.<place_id>.<mode>`, and carries the weight
of the journeys, which count as one thing between them.
CompareRow.title: CompareRow

CompareStatus.description:
`ranked`, or the reason the area was filtered or left unranked.

One enum and not a union of three, so that a generated client gets one
type. A test holds it to `FilterReason` and `UnrankedReason`.
CompareStatus.title: CompareStatus

Confidence.description: What a cost rests on. The first three are of a range Burro worked out.
Confidence.title: Confidence

CostEstimate.description:
What a home of one kind costs in one area: a range, or one number where no range is known.

A row holds both quartiles or neither. A row with neither is a median of
what was paid for the homes that were sold, and is one of two things. A
publisher's own median is of the twelve months that end with `as_of`, and
what it rests on is `unstated`: the publisher gives no count of the sales.
A median worked out from the sales themselves says how many it rests on,
in `sales`, and the first month they were made in, in `since`. Nothing
stands in for the range of either.

A rent may be of a wider place than the area: no publisher gives one for
an area. It is then a range as its publisher gives it for the place, and
says the place in `of`, how many rents were recorded there in `rents`,
and the first month of them in `since`. Every area of the place that
takes its figure holds the same row.
CostEstimate.title: CostEstimate

CostOf.description:
The place a cost is of, where it is of a wider place than the area.

A postcode district the area lies in, by what stands before the space of
its postcodes, or the borough the area is in, by its name. A cost that is
of the area alone holds none.
CostOf.title: CostOf

CostOfKind.description:
The kind of place a cost is of, where it is of a wider place than the area.

No publisher gives a rent for an area. One gives the rents that were
recorded in a postcode district and in a borough, and an area is given the
figure of the place it lies in.
CostOfKind.title: CostOfKind

Cutoffs.description: The longest journey the release routed, by mode. Anything longer is `beyond_cutoff`.
Cutoffs.title: Cutoffs

Describes.description: What a feature is a fact about.
Describes.title: Describes

Family.description: The groups of the settings, in the order they are shown.
Family.title: Family

FeatureKind.description: What a person may want of a feature, which decides where it may stand.
FeatureKind.title: FeatureKind

FilterReason.description: In the order the filters are applied. An area stops at the first that catches it.
FilterReason.title: FilterReason

Geometry.description: A GeoJSON geometry object: a polygon or a multipolygon, in WGS84.
Geometry.title: Geometry

GrittyVariant.description: Whether a release carries Gritty, the one vibe that counts recorded crime.
GrittyVariant.title: GrittyVariant

Holds.description:
What a release holds to answer a search with, apart from its measures and its vibes.

A first build holds neither. A client then says so where a person would
look for it, and offers no control that could only be turned away.
Holds.title: Holds

HowEstimated.description: The numbers an estimate is made with, for a page of methods to print.

minutes_a_km_near_the_underground.title: Minutes A Km Near The Underground

HowEstimated.title: HowEstimated

IncomeOffer.description: What the closed block of an area's page says. It holds no figure and names no area.
IncomeOffer.title: IncomeOffer

IncomeShown.description:
The figure of one area, as its page shows it. Every word but a button's is here.

A figure is said in words, as it is to be printed: `£52,300`. `limits`
holds both limits as they are printed, `£46,100 to £59,300`, so that no
client joins two figures. Where the publisher gives none for the area,
`estimate` and the limits are `None` and `none_given` says so.
IncomeShown.title: IncomeShown

InterpretStatus.description: In the order that decides the status: the first that applies wins.
InterpretStatus.title: InterpretStatus

JourneyBand.description: Where an estimated journey stands against the limit a person gave. Never minutes.
JourneyBand.title: JourneyBand

Metric.description: A feature this release carries. Core decides what it is; the release says where from.
Metric.title: Metric

NameState.description: How far the name an area bears has been checked.
NameState.title: NameState

Named.description:
What is known of the name an area bears, where it is not its publisher's label.

An area is drawn as its publisher draws it, and its publisher labels it
with a borough and a number. Where the area bears the name of a
neighbourhood, this says what the label was, who wrote the name, and
whether a person has checked it. A name is a draft until one has.
Named.title: Named

NamedPlace.description:
A place a spec names, by the release's own name for it. Never what was typed.

A spec holds a `place_id` and no name. A name says where someone works as
an id does, so it is handled as one: served in a body, and in no log.
NamedPlace.title: NamedPlace

NotInRelease.description:
A thing a person asked for that the release holds for no area, so none is ranked on it.

A vibe that no area has a band for, a measure the release does not carry,
a budget where it holds no cost of that kind of home, a journey where it
names no place. It is said, so that a person is told what is not there
yet. It is never offered, and nothing stands in for it.
NotInRelease.title: NotInRelease

OpsGroup.description: The six arrays of `Operations`, in the order the reducer applies them.
OpsGroup.title: OpsGroup

OptionKind.description: What a clarification offers: a place of one of the kinds of 2.7, or an area.
OptionKind.title: OptionKind

PlaceKind.description: In the order that breaks a tie between two matches of the same score.
PlaceKind.title: PlaceKind

PortraitMark.description: One vibe on the portrait. The band and the sentence are in the fact it names.
PortraitMark.title: PortraitMark

PortraitPart.description: One part of a recipe, and the fact that holds this area's figure for it.
PortraitPart.title: PortraitPart

Problem.description: What is wrong with one field. A code, never the value that was sent.
Problem.title: Problem

Reader.description:
Who reads what a person types, and what people are told of it.

It is how the service is set, and no part of the release. A client shows
`notice` by the box before anything is typed, as it is served, and writes
no provider's name or terms of its own.
Reader.title: Reader

RecipeHeld.description:
How much of one vibe's recipe a release carries, and what the vibe waits on.

It is of the release and of no area. An area may have a figure for fewer
parts than the release carries, and its own fact says so.
RecipeHeld.title: RecipeHeld

RentsSaid.description:
What is said of the rents of a release, where each is of a wider place than an area.

It holds words and no figure. A client shows them where no one area is
spoken of: the first beside the count of the areas a firm budget to rent
left out, and the second on the page of methods.
RentsSaid.title: RentsSaid

RestsOn.description:
Which words of the text an edit rests on: where they start and end, never the words.

`start` and `end` count the characters of the text as it was typed, as
Python counts them, so `text[start:end]` is the words. An edit made of
several parts, as a budget is of "renting", "2 bed" and "£1,500", has one
of these for each part. They are for showing a person which of their
words made each edit. Nothing stores or logs them.
RestsOn.title: RestsOn

RoughGuide.description: What stands beside a vibe that is a rough guide, wherever the vibe is shown.
RoughGuide.title: RoughGuide

ServedLimits.description:
The limits of section 5.2, with the cutoffs of the release that is loaded.

A form that keeps to these never offers a value the reducer would refuse.
ServedLimits.title: ServedLimits

ShareData.description: A shared search, ranked now on the release that is loaded.
ShareData.title: ShareData

Similar.description: One of the areas most like this one. The sentence is in the `likeness` fact it names.
Similar.title: Similar

Span.description: A stretch of the text: where it starts and ends, counted as `RestsOn` counts.
Span.title: Span

StripMark.description: Where an area sits on one vibe, for the strip under its name. Shown, never scored.
StripMark.title: StripMark

Suggestion.description:
An offer: a thing that was noticed, in four parts. The person chooses.

What it would do (`does`), the person's own words (`spans`, shown within
`shown`), what follows for areas (`follows`), and the choices. Every word
is Burro's own. The person's words are never here: a client cuts them
from the text it holds, by where they stand.
Suggestion.title: Suggestion

SuggestionChoice.description:
One way a person may take an offer, and the edits it would make.

It has a name of its own here because core has another `Choice`, what a
setting is set to, and one document cannot hold two records of one name.
SuggestionChoice.title: SuggestionChoice

SuggestionDirection.description: What a person may choose of a thing the reader noticed. It never guesses one.
SuggestionDirection.title: SuggestionDirection

Sureness.description:
Whether a vibe is as sure as the rest, or a rough guide. It says so of itself.

It has these two values and no other. It is no number, and no word of praise or
blame: it says how far a vibe is to be trusted, and nothing of any place. No client
works it out. A vibe that does not say is as sure as the rest.
Sureness.title: Sureness

TagId.description:
On screen a tag is a vibe. Seven ids of catalogue version 1 are retired and never reused:
buzzy, evening_venues, historic_character, creative, strong_high_street,
near_universities and waterside.
TagId.title: TagId

TagValue.description:
Where one area sits on one vibe. `score` is for ranking and is never printed.

`band` is what is shown: one of five, counted from the low end. The
spread is the bands the middle half of the area's homes span, so a mixed
area is drawn as a range and never as a point in the middle.
TagValue.title: TagValue

Toward.description: Which end of a vibe is asked for. A one-way vibe has the high end alone.
Toward.title: Toward

UnmetAt.description: Something that was asked for which nothing measures, and where it was said.
UnmetAt.title: UnmetAt

WaitsOn.description: A part of a recipe that a release carries no measure for. It is named, never filled in.
WaitsOn.title: WaitsOn

info.description: Ranks named neighbourhoods for a preference spec and shows its working. Every response says whether the data behind it is synthetic, and whether the release is a preview that is not finished.
info.title: Burro API

get.description: Whether the service is up. It says nothing about the release, so it has no `meta`.
Every area of the release, by id, and where each sits on every vibe.

304.description: The release the caller holds is still loaded

get.description: The boundary of every area, as a GeoJSON feature collection.

304.description: The release the caller holds is still loaded

get.description: One area: what the release holds about it, and the facts a profile page shows.

304.description: The release the caller holds is still loaded

get.description: The census figures of one area, beside the figures of the whole city and nothing else.
The household income of one area, as its publisher estimates it, and nothing else.

post.description: Two to four areas side by side, the rows in the order of the person's own weights.
A few checked sentences about each of the top areas, and the facts they cite.
Read a request in words into typed edits, and apply them to the spec.

get.description: The release that is loaded, the vocabulary, the defaults, the limits, and who reads.

304.description: The release the caller holds is still loaded

post.description: The places and the areas that match, each best first.
Apply any edits to the spec, then rank every area of the release for it.
Store a search and give back the id of a link to it.

get.description: A shared search, ranked now on the release that is loaded.
